node.statement: Raw-call packaging and complete t_1 ledger. Use the Stage-1 tag and record the supplied input map w, the named source C^{m+1}, the target pieces P_old,P_fresh, base scale t_1, the literal output sum map v_old plus v_fresh when m>1 and v_fresh alone when m=1, and the fixed amplification families just constructed; these are precisely the data fields of def-maincb-raw-call. Nodes 1.2-1.4 supply complementary target projections, the old extended inclusion when present, and the fresh extended inclusion. Every relevant projection, complementarity, and map defect is bounded respectively by c_0^cb*epsilon, L*epsilon, C_co*(c_0^cb+1)*epsilon, or C_pair*L*epsilon, and every ambient defect used is epsilon or L*epsilon; each is at most t_1 because K_1 dominates its coefficient. Node 1.1 gives 0<=t_1<=e_1. Thus this explicit Stage-1 raw-call datum meets every hypothesis of lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement at base scale t_1.
